description: Documentation HTML page for the Opencart Admin Model class GeoZone, detailing its methods and inheritance structure.

classes.name: Opencart.Admin.Model.Localisation.GeoZone
classes.description: A class representing geographic zones within the Opencart localisation module, extending the base Model class and providing methods to manage geo zones and zones.

methods.name: addGeoZone
methods.description: Adds a new geo zone with specified data.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Associative array of data to create the geo zone

methods.name: editGeoZone
methods.description: Edits an existing geo zone identified by its ID with new data.

parameters.name: geo_zone_id
parameters.description: ID of the geo zone to edit

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: New data for the geo zone

methods.name: deleteGeoZone
methods.description: Deletes the specified geo zone by its ID.

parameters.name: geo_zone_id
parameters.description: ID of the geo zone to delete

methods.name: getGeoZone
methods.description: Retrieves data for a specific geo zone by its ID.

methods.name: getGeoZones
methods.description: Retrieves a list of geo zones, optionally filtered by criteria.

methods.name: getTotalGeoZones
methods.description: Returns the total number of geo zones.

methods.name: addZone
methods.description: Adds a zone to a geo zone.

parameters.name: geo_zone_id
parameters.description: ID of the geo zone to add the zone to

methods.name: deleteZones
methods.description: Deletes zones within a geo zone by its ID.

methods.name: getZones
methods.description: Retrieves zones associated with a geo zone.

methods.name: getTotalZones
methods.description: Returns total number of zones for a given geo zone ID.

methods.name: getTotalZonesByCountryId
methods.description: Returns total zones for a given country ID.

methods.name: getTotalZonesByZoneId
methods.description: Returns total zones for a specific zone ID.
